claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Uranus introduces unexpected disruption into Saturnine structures and prevents order from becoming excessively rigid.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus = disruption of over-stabilized Saturnine structure.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Uranus represents the random element of mutation necessary for creative innovation.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus = random mutation enabling creative innovation.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75

claims.author: Robert Hand

claims.author: Robert Hand

claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Its position among the normally invisible planets is symbolically connected with energies at the periphery of ordinary awareness that appear alien to normal consciousness.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus operates at the edge of ordinary awareness and can introduce apparently alien contents into consciousness.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Along with Neptune, Uranus is associated with alternative states of consciousness.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Uranian energies operate suddenly and with extreme eccentricity; what they affect tends toward the unusual and far from everyday norms.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: At the impersonal/social level Uranus signifies disruptions of established social order, including revolution and natural disaster.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus collective domains: disruption of social order, revolution, impersonal disruptive events.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Uranus is associated with innovative technologies and the sciences.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus domains: innovative technology and science.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Life requires a balance between Saturn's ordering forces and Uranus's chaotic forces; either unchecked becomes problematic.
claims.normalized_claim: Saturn/Uranus polarity = order versus creative chaos; viable life requires balance between them.

claims.author: Robert Hand
claims.edition: Horoscope Symbols, 1981 Para Research / Schiffer ISBN 9780914918165
claims.locus: Ch.4 The Planets: Core Meanings — Uranus, pp.72-75
claims.original_claim: Although Uranian energies can be extremely difficult, the measure of chaos they introduce is essential to life and continuing growth.
claims.normalized_claim: Constructive Uranus = enough instability to prevent stagnation and permit continued growth.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Saturn forms; Uranus transforms. Uranus invalidates the Saturnian equation of destiny by opening new vistas; it does not merely alter contents inside an unchanged form.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus = transformation of form, polar to Saturn's forming.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: The great keyword of Uranus is through: it pierces every Saturnian wall and every opaque veil, flashing the light of the realm just beyond.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus keyword: through — piercing Saturnian walls toward the next realm.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Uranus is the rouser of doubt, breaker of static faith, iconoclast. He throws the challenge What if there were something beyond the taken-for-granted?
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus = iconoclastic What-if challenge to unquestioned postulates.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Changing the contents of the ego is modification, which inner-Saturn planets can do. Uranian transformation reconstructs the form of selfhood itself: not only contents but the container must be gone through.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranian transformation reconstructs the form of selfhood, not mere modification of contents.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Jupiter expands what Saturn formed; the ego may swell yet remain the same ego. Uranus directly challenges Saturn's exclusivism and rigidity. Do not treat Jupiter-expansion as Uranian transformation.
claims.normalized_claim: Jupiter expands Saturn's form; Uranus challenges Saturn's power itself.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Regeneration loosely names the whole process, but strictly it is Pluto's last phase. Uranus transforms; Neptune dissolves and feeds prenatal growth; Pluto is hierophant of birth into the New World.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus transforms only one phase; regeneration is Pluto, not Uranus.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Uranian operation is two-fold: piercing through Saturn, then projecting images of a more universal world onto the inner walls of the ego.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus: pierce Saturn, then project images of the beyond.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Uranus can link with every planet; his action is protean, with no definite form, adjusting to every psychological or social function.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus action is protean: no fixed form, adjusts to every faculty.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: He who conquers death has become transformed: the form is renewed, the Self remains with a new formula of operation and an expanded viewpoint. This is metamorphosis.
claims.normalized_claim: Constructive Uranus: metamorphosis — Self remains, form and viewpoint renew.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: Once transformation begins there is no going back. The form must be renewed or break. Failure to metamorphose is death: withdrawal into Saturnian fear. Uranus is pitiless toward those who cannot let go of past idols.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus shadow: refuse metamorphosis and the form breaks; no return to the old form.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: From the viewpoint of human Personality, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are a triune Path linking Personality to a vaster Being, not definite factors in Personality itself.
claims.normalized_claim: Trans-Saturnians = a path/process for Personality, not factors inside Personality.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Uranus, Master of Transformations
claims.original_claim: The cycle of transformations at the individual level is the 84-year cycle of Uranus. Recurring; not a one-shot natal trait.
claims.normalized_claim: Individual Uranus transformation-cycle = 84 years.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: Uranus is best understood archetypally as Prometheus, who stole fire from the heavens in rebellion against the gods to give humankind greater freedom — not as the sky-god Ouranos.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus = Prometheus (fire stolen for human freedom), not the sky-god Ouranos.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: Uranus represents the principle of change, of freedom, rebellion, and revolution.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus themes: change, freedom, rebellion, revolution — as Promethean principle, not generic unrest.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: It is associated with unexpected phenomena of all kinds, with sudden surprises and awakenings, with breakthroughs — intellectual, psychological, spiritual.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus theme: sudden surprise, awakening, and breakthrough (mind/psyche/spirit).

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: It governs the sudden breakup of established structures, and tends to have an exciting and electric quality.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus function: sudden breakup of established structures; electric quality.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: The Promethean impulse associated with Uranus is that part of us that seeks to go our own way, to choose our own individual path in life.
claims.normalized_claim: Constructive Uranus: Promethean impulse to choose an individual path.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: In less exalted forms Uranus can signify only eccentricity or lawlessness; in its highest expression, real genius and significant personal or cultural breakthroughs.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus polarity: eccentricity/lawlessness versus genius and significant breakthroughs.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: If the Promethean impulse toward creative freedom is not integrated, one tends to experience this archetype as upsetting change forced from without, rather than as inner independence.
claims.normalized_claim: Unintegrated Uranus is felt as forced change from outside, not as inner Promethean freedom.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: Uranus confronts the Saturnian part of us that wishes to hold on, to maintain the status quo, to resist change in favor of security, tradition, and the established order.
claims.normalized_claim: Uranus confronts the Saturnian wish to hold status quo, security, and tradition.

claims.author: Richard Tarnas
claims.edition: An Introduction to Archetypal Astrology; cosmosandpsyche.com PDF
claims.locus: Official PDF — Uranus / Prometheus section
claims.original_claim: Its influence inclines one to be changeable, restless, and unpredictable — sometimes irresponsibly so — in a constant quest for personal freedom and new experience.
claims.normalized_claim: Shadow: restless, unpredictable quest for freedom that can become irresponsible.
